acceptanceCriteria: A dispatch config can declare shared prompt fragments once and reference them from any role prompt; the rendered prompt is byte-identical to the equivalent inline prompt, and its digest is unchanged.
Unknown, unused-by-policy, cyclic or oversized fragment references refuse at load with a stable code and name the role and fragment; the per-role rendered prompt keeps its existing byte limit.
A config without fragments loads and renders exactly as before (regression test).
The leases spec carries numbered proposed requirements, traceability and rollback for the fragment syntax.
body: Owner request https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/656 (2026-10-07). A dispatch config with 21 roles repeats a 6-8 KB rules block in every role `prompt`; adding one 250-character rule pushed dispatch.json to 270046 bytes and `dispatch status` refused it with LIMIT_EXCEEDED (file larger than 262144 bytes, internal/tasks/dispatch/config.go MaxConfig). About 86 KB is text repeated in at least 15 roles. Ask: a top-level fragment map that roles reference and that expands at render time, keeping the rendered prompt and its digest exactly as before; alternatives are a role promptFile or a raised cap for the config file only.
